_about: Items outside the Foundry marketplace that a stranger can reach. Every repo was checked with an anonymous request on 2026-11-09, and every install line was checked against the repo's README and the files it names. 'unrated' means the item was not part of the Foundry's recorded test runs; its own README states its limits.

items.name: claude-bug-squash
items.summary: Report a bug and it triages, fixes in an isolated git worktree, proves the bug goes red to green, and gates every fix behind blast-radius caps, a never-touch list and a three-seat review panel.
items.install: claude plugin marketplace add jddavenportOpen/claude-bug-squash && claude plugin install claude-bug-squash@claude-bug-squash
limits: An autonomous merge needs a repro command that fails while the bug is present and passes once it is fixed. Without one, fixes cannot auto-merge.
At most one auto-merge a day by default.

items.name: recruit (recruit-copilot)
items.maturity_note: Labeled beta in the Foundry marketplace's own recorded runs.
items.summary: Merge the resumes you already have into one experience bank, score open roles against goals you set, tailor a resume per posting, and check that a machine can still read it. It never applies for you.
items.install: claude plugin marketplace add jddavenportOpen/recruit-copilot && claude plugin install recruit@recruit-copilot
limits: The round-trip check proves the text is present and readable in order. It cannot prove every commercial ATS parses it, so never call it ATS-verified.
The built-in PDF reader handles common resume PDFs, not every PDF.

items.name: Clawdacademy (ai-fluency-trainer)
items.summary: Scores seven judgment behaviors in your real Claude Code sessions, names your weakest habit and coaches in the flow of work.
items.install_note: Its one-line installer runs a script from a third domain. Read the repo's README and install script before you run it.
limits: Sync is opt-in and needs a token. Read the data section of the README before you turn it on.

items.name: contact-list-builder
items.summary: Builds a verified list of public business contacts for customer interviews or prospecting. Parallel research lanes, then a script re-downloads every source page to prove each email and phone is there.
items.install: git clone https://github.com/jddavenportOpen/contact-list-builder ~/.claude/skills/contact-list-builder
limits: Public pages only, and guessed emails are never shown as real.
Needs Python 3. pdftotext is optional, for contacts that appear only in PDFs.

items.name: instinct-handoff
items.summary: Routing rules, a Claude Code skill and an AGENTS.md for handing work from your agent system to Instinct, an outside autonomous agent.
items.install: git clone https://github.com/jddavenportOpen/instinct-standing-doc && mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r instinct-standing-doc/skills/instinct-handoff ~/.claude/skills/
limits: Unofficial and not affiliated with Instinct.
Useful only if you use Instinct.

items.name: deep-research-agent
items.summary: An iterative research agent: a knowledge-gap loop over nine parallel sources, a devil's-advocate pass, and per-claim three-vote verification.
items.install: git clone https://github.com/jddavenportOpen/deep-research-agent.git && cd deep-research-agent && pip install -r requirements.txt
limits: Live runs need your own API keys in .env.
Its tests run offline with stubs; a live run is what costs money.

items.name: ai-phone-desk
items.summary: Gives your agents a phone. Nothing dials until a human approves the exact request.
items.install: git clone https://github.com/jddavenportOpen/ai-phone-desk && cd ai-phone-desk && pip install -e .
limits: Rehearsal is text, not voice.
Calls cost money (Vapi bills per minute).
US and Canada numbers only.

items.name: orchestra-agents
items.summary: Multi-agent orchestration and an eval harness on Claude: fleet fan-out, a durable message bus, a circuit breaker, best-of-N with an adversarial judge, and a definition-of-done gate.
items.install: git clone https://github.com/jddavenportOpen/orchestra-agents && cd orchestra-agents && pip install -e ".[dev]"
limits: The tests run offline; live runs need your own Anthropic API key.

items.name: mcp-judge
items.summary: A calibrated multi-persona LLM judge exposed as an MCP server, with an eval harness that shows the calibration.
items.install: git clone https://github.com/jddavenportOpen/mcp-judge && cd mcp-judge && pip install -e .
limits: Scoring and the eval harness need your own Anthropic API key.

items.name: ethos-gate
items.summary: A PreToolUse safety gate that blocks irreversible or outward-facing actions (sends, spends, deploys) unless a human approved that exact content.
items.install: git clone https://github.com/jddavenportOpen/ethos-gate && cd ethos-gate && pip install -e .
limits: Install from source. The README's pip install ethos-gate line does not work yet: the package is not on PyPI.

items.name: Clawdling
items.summary: Your Claude Code as a whole org: an agent for each project on one map, showing who is working and who needs you, with a receipt when one says done. Local, on your own Claude plan.
items.install: Set up Clawdling for me from https://github.com/jddavenportOpen/clawdling and follow SETUP.md
limits: Needs a paid Claude plan (Pro, Max, Team or Enterprise). On Pro, run one or two agents at a time.
AGPL-3.0: if you run a modified version as a service, you must share your changes.

items.name: clawd-agent-os
items.summary: Tiered Claude agent hierarchies: worktree-isolated fleet spawning, a durable agent bus that never silently returns empty, and one registry for model tiers.
items.install: git clone https://github.com/jddavenportOpen/clawd-agent-os && cd clawd-agent-os && pip install -e ".[dev]"
limits: Needs the Claude Code CLI on your PATH.
The durable bus needs a Postgres or Supabase table you provide.

items.name: warden
items.summary: A governor for autonomous agents: autonomy is admitted by how reversible an action is, not by how confident the agent sounds. Zero dependencies.
items.install: git clone https://github.com/jddavenportOpen/warden && cd warden && pip install -e .
limits: It checks that an undo exists, not that the undo works.
It governs actions, not prompts. It is not a jailbreak defense.

items.name: fleetwright
items.summary: A self-hosted agent operations OS: a persistent chief of staff that commands a fleet of agents, with a bridge and a web cockpit.
items.install: git clone https://github.com/jddavenportOpen/fleetwright.git && cd fleetwright && bash scripts/bootstrap.sh
limits: The bridge needs access to your own claude CLI.
The cockpit is a Node app you run locally.

items.name: ccstitch
items.summary: A local trace store for Claude Code's OpenTelemetry spans that repairs orphaned headless turns and nests child sessions under the tool call that launched them.
items.install: pipx install git+https://github.com/jddavenportOpen/ccstitch && ccstitch install --dry-run
limits: Depends on a Claude Code telemetry beta; span names can change in any release.
Single machine, single user, no authentication beyond the local bind.
Costs it shows are list-price estimates.

items.name: harnessview
items.summary: Inspect and visualize your agent harness (agents, skills, hooks, MCP servers) and its run history, and spot broken config.
items.install: git clone https://github.com/jddavenportOpen/harnessview && cd harnessview && npm install && npm run dev
limits: Run it from a clone. The README's npx harnessview line does not work yet: the package is not on npm.

items.name: context-kit
items.summary: Four Markdown templates and five Claude Code skills that give an agent permanent personal context: a wiki, mental models, voice and protocols.
items.install: git clone https://github.com/jddavenportOpen/context-kit.git && cd context-kit && bash scripts/install.sh
limits: The templates are yours to fill. What you put in them is what your agent will know.

items.name: claude-deploy-kit
items.summary: Enterprise controls for deploying Claude agents: a policy chokepoint, a destructive-command deny hook, an eval gate, a redacting audit log and pluggable secrets.
items.install: git clone https://github.com/jddavenportOpen/claude-deploy-kit && cd claude-deploy-kit && pip install -e ".[dev]"
limits: Identity, secrets backends and data residency are decisions the code leaves to you; the architecture doc covers them.

items.name: app-feedback-loop
items.summary: A build spec for an in-app feedback loop: one click captures a screenshot and context, an agent fixes the bug with that context loaded, and the fix commit thanks the reporter.
items.install: Read https://github.com/ai-foundry-byu/app-feedback-loop/blob/main/SPEC.md and implement this feedback loop natively in my stack. When you believe you are done, run the checks in VERIFY.md and show me the results.
limits: It is a spec, not a library. Your agent builds it in your stack, so review what it builds.

items.name: agent-team-kit
items.summary: A working setup for running many Claude Code agents on one app without collisions: port assignment, a schema lock, git guards and gates, plus mockup and bug-fix skills.
items.install_note: The repo has no license file yet, so we do not list an install line. Read it, and ask before you reuse it.
limits: No license file yet.

items.name: agent-evals-starter
items.summary: Learn agent evals by running them: a support agent, 24 tasks, code graders, an LLM judge, and do-nothing and pushover controls. Runs offline.
items.install: git clone https://github.com/jddavenportOpen/agent-evals-starter.git && cd agent-evals-starter && pip install -r requirements.txt
limits: The judge labels were drafted with AI for teaching. Real judge labels must come from a person.
24 tasks catch big differences, not small ones.

items.name: mastery-engine
items.summary: Generates a curriculum from source material on disk, with mastery gates and claims checked against the source.
items.install: git clone https://github.com/jddavenportOpen/mastery-engine && cd mastery-engine && pip install -e .
limits: Version 0.1.0. No learner has yet gone from a generated curriculum to a cleared readiness gate over real calendar time.

items.name: The Software Design Canon
items.summary: A curated, link-checked index of the free primary sources on software design and architecture. No pirated books.
items.install_note: Nothing to install. Read it, or point your agent at it.
limits: The repo records who holds the rights to each source; check before you copy one.
